attempts.text:
The only designated evacuation point is Shivapuri shelter, so every rescue trip must end there. Kispang temple doesn't count as a drop-off. The plan rescues all 11 elderly people in three round trips from the shelter, with no one deferred.

**Trips:**
- **Kalika village:** 4 elderly, round trip of 7 + 7 = 14 minutes. Deferring them would cost 4 × 50 = 200.
- **Trishuli farm:** 7 elderly. The direct road is 39 minutes each way, which is faster than going through Kispang temple (45 + 9 = 54). The car holds four, so this needs two round trips of 78 minutes each.
  - Trip with 4 people: 78 minutes, versus 200 to defer them.
  - Trip with 3 people: 78 minutes, versus 150 to defer them.

**Total:** 14 + 78 + 78 = 170 minutes of driving, with no deferral penalties.

<plan>
drive car1 shivapuri-shelter kalika-village
load car1 elderly 4
drive car1 kalika-village shivapuri-shelter
unload car1 elderly 4
drive car1 shivapuri-shelter trishuli-farm
load car1 elderly 4
drive car1 trishuli-farm shivapuri-shelter
unload car1 elderly 4
drive car1 shivapuri-shelter trishuli-farm
load car1 elderly 3
drive car1 trishuli-farm shivapuri-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
</plan>
